title: UserProfileChanged
description: Published by Auth & Users to farol.auth-users with routing key user-profile.changed, through the outbox (ADR-004): when an account is created at its first GET /api/v1/me (API outline §1.4) and, from US-04, when its display name changes. Consumed from events.auth-users-events and reports.auth-users-events (API outline §7.4, §7.5). Full state with a version: consumers upsert their copy and ignore a version not newer than the one they have (§7.3). Carries no e-mail (assessment M-10): an e-mail change publishes nothing (spec D5). actorUserId is the sub of the user who caused it. AMQP properties: message_id = messageId, type = UserProfileChanged, app_id = auth-users, correlation_id = the request's X-Correlation-Id, content_type application/json, persistent.

eventId.description: An account belongs to no Farol event

displayName.description: The name claim trimmed and cut to 100 characters, or the e-mail's local part (spec D5)
